title: Self and peer check: recording and improving: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Muddaththir and madd in recitation
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Self and peer check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 24. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Self-check
points: At home: record, with a parent's permission

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the checklist used to assess recitation

questions.q: Give precise feedback: a pupil reads «يَتَسَآءَلُونَ» (74:40) with a 2-count madd.
Breakout pairs: recite half the surah each, give one precise target, then recite again (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites to the teacher.
questions.a: Two attempts with a recorded target and improvement.

questions.q: Extend: write your three most common slips this half term.
Stretch: give feedback to two different partners.

options: Naming one real target with the ayah
questions.a: A) Naming one real target with the ayah. One real, specific target leads to improvement.

questions.q: Think again: Is it easier to hear mistakes in someone else's recitation or in your own? Why?
questions.a: Usually others'; we hear what we expect in our own. Recording or a partner helps us hear honestly.
